objective: Preallocate ANALYZE data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate ANALYZE data prefixes
tasks.result: ANALYZE table-stat collection now uses an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

verification.status: passed: helper and matching analyze tests

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in ANALYZE table-stat scan prefix construction.
Generated prefix bytes, transaction scan prefixes, row-cache lookups, row decoding, distinct stats, min/max stats, EXPLAIN statistics, and SQL results are unchanged.
